scenario: Cache write `ttl:` accepts a `Duration`-typed binding as well as literal durations per LSTO.4.2. The TTL may be a computed value from a pattern binding. Pin: `cache key: "k" value: t.v ttl: t.delay`, where `delay: Duration`, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: nothing is written or expires.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
    delay: Duration mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    cache key: "k" value: t.v ttl: t.delay
